question: The novel ‘Train to Pakistan’ was written by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khushwant Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The novel **'Train to Pakistan'** was written by **Khushwant Singh**.
 
• Published in **1956**, the novel is a** poignant portrayal of the partition of India in 1947**, focusing on the human cost of the political upheaval.
 
• Khushwant Singh is a renowned Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, journalist, and politician, known for his sharp wit and profound literary contributions.
 
• 'Train to Pakistan' is considered one of his most significant works, providing a vivid narrative of the communal violence and the impact on ordinary people during the partition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Khushwant Singh (1915-2014) was born in Hadali, Punjab (now in Pakistan).
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan in 1974 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2007**, two of India's highest civilian honors.
 
• Besides 'Train to Pakistan', some of his other notable works include '**The History of Sikhs**', '**Delhi: A Novel**', and '**The Company of Women**'.
 
• Khushwant Singh was also known for his journalism, having edited several prestigious Indian magazines and newspapers.
 
• His works continue to be celebrated for their insightful observations, rich storytelling, and deep empathy for human experiences.
